notes: The C++ submissions are RTE or WA, so there is no accepted reference. orig.cpp is corpus-written (reverse construction counting the leaves each L must grow); any minimum tree is accepted (checker.py checks N against the reference and simulates the operations). It matches an exhaustive search over every labelled tree with N <= 9 on 1800 generated cases, and checker.py accepts its tree on all of them and on --max (about 10^6 vertices). On 800 more cases up to Q = 2000 checker.py accepts every tree, and on the 629 unperturbed ones N never exceeds gen.py's hidden tree. A port of EgorKulikov/rust_algo's archived solution was tried first and rejected: it misses the minimum both ways (e.g. `5 / D 1 4 / L / L / D 3 2 / D 5 2` gives 7, whose tree fails, the minimum is 8).
